leadText: Loblolly (Japanese: シタン Citan) is a character in the Generation V core series .
plainText:
Loblolly (Japanese: シタン Citan) is a character in the Generation V core series . 

==In the core series games==
In , the may find Loblolly in the southeast section of Nacrene City, where her studio is located. After visiting the at least once, Loblolly will talk about Décor that "people will dream of". Players may choose one of five pieces of Décor that will be unlocked in the Dream World the next time the Game Sync is used. Each day, another piece may be chosen.

===Quotes===
Nacrene City
If talked to without visiting the Dream World
"My name is Loblolly. I'm a designer of Décor items. But I'm stuck now... I just can't come up with a good design. I've been thinking about Décor so great that it will appear in a dream..."

===Sprites===
 

==In the manga==
===Pokémon Adventures===
Loblolly appears in The Mystery of the Missing Fossil. , while touring through each of Nacrene City's shops, visited Loblolly's studio to look at furniture.
